title: Exploiting thiolate/disulfide redox couples toward large-scale electrochemical carbon dioxide capture and release
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2584-2598
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04739G, Paper
Xiaoxin Li, Chao Deng, Rong Chen, Xu Li, Furong Xie, Zinan Wu, Yu Xie, Song Wang, Guo-Ming Weng
